chunks: The letter of Abī Muḥammad (عليه السلام) used to arrive concerning the stipend for al-Junayd, the killer of Fāris, and Abī al-Ḥasan and another.
So when Abū Muḥammad (عليه السلام) passed away, a resumption came from the Master regarding the stipend of Abī al-Ḥasan and his companion, and nothing came concerning the matter of al-Junayd.
He said: I became grieved because of that, then the news of al-Junayd’s death arrived after that.

key_terms.أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ: Abū Muḥammad, the Imam al-Ḥasan al-ʿAskarī (عليه السلام)
key_terms.الصَّاحِبِ: the Master, referring here to the succeeding authority
key_terms.نَعْيُ: news of death or obituary notice

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the continuation of authority and disbursement after Abū Muḥammad (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This report recounts correspondence concerning financial disbursement during the time of Abū Muḥammad (عليه السلام) and after his passing. It highlights the continuation of authority from the Ṣāḥib and notes that the omission of al-Junayd from further disbursement was followed by news of his death.
